messages:
ellie: Heads-up — planned Dedicated capacity cutover for gpu-pool-epsilon today at 16:00 UTC. Scope: autoscaler policy change (min=2 -> 3, burst window tweaks) + new runtime image v2.3.1. Who's owning deploy, smoke, and rollback?

rajiv: I can own the deploy and config push. Will be on standby from 15:30 UTC.

marco: I can run the smoke suite and do throughput/latency QuickChecks after cutover (15m). Will validate tail-latency and token cost.

ellie: Awesome. @taylor can you monitor console (routes/model dashboard) + tracing and be ready to trigger rollback on error spike? Define rollback condition please.

taylor: Yep. Rollback criteria: 1) 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m OR 2) p95 inference latency increases > 60% vs baseline for 5m OR 3) error budget burn > 5% in 10m. I'll post go/no-go at 15:50 UTC. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [scheduled] Deployment job queued: deploy-gpu-epsilon-v2.3.1 by @rajiv at 16:00 UTC. CI: ✅ all checks passed (build + unit tests). Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/4223

marco: Smoke checklist (short):
```
# validate basic health
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pools/epsilon/health | jq .
# quick generation sanity
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-e-1","prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":8}' | jq .
# verify autoscaler config
redwood capacity show --pool epsilon | grep -E "min|max|burst_window"
```
I'll run those at +5m after cutover and again at +20m.

rajiv: Deploy steps (short):
1) push config change to infra repo: `git push origin feature/epsilon-autoscale`
2) infra CI -> apply to staging -> canary 10% for 5m
3) cutover to 100% with drain window 60s
4) tag release `epsilon:v2.3.1`
Rollback is `infra/rollback.py --pool epsilon --to-tag epsilon:v2.3.0` (automated, safe drain).

ellie: Good. @sre-oncall are there any cluster constraints today (maintenance windows, capacity pressure) we should be aware of?

sre-oncall: No infra maintenance on schedule. GPU headroom at normal levels. Watch the cluster pod eviction logs during drain: `kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=epsilon -f`. If we see OOMs across nodes, abort and rollback.

marco: One extra check: KV cache warming may change first-token latency — I'll monitor first-byte latency separately. If first-byte p50 > baseline*2 for 10m we rollback.

taylor: I'll publish a quick dashboard panel for p50/p95 and 5xx, link here when ready.

ellie: Can everyone react with :eyes: if they can be present in thread at deploy time? If you're not available, add a delegate.

rajiv: :eyes: I'll be on video call (zoom.me/epsilon-cutover) starting 15:50 UTC.

marco: :eyes:

taylor: :eyes:

deploy-bot: [info] Canary (10%) completed at 16:05 UTC — observability checks OK.

marco: Ran smoke @16:10 UTC: all smoke commands returned expected responses. p95 latency +8% vs baseline, 5xx=0. No anomalies in cost counters.

taylor: Dashboard posted: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/epsilon-cutover — monitoring for p95/p50/5xx. I'm on watch.

rajiv: Gradual ramp to 100% started at 16:15 UTC.

sre-oncall: Noted small spike in pod restarts during ramp (2 nodes) — investigating but restarts are not OOMs. Keeping an eye.

marco: Post-ramp check @16:30 UTC: p95 stabilized at +12%, 5xx=0.2% (below rollback threshold). Throughput within expected range.

ellie: Thanks team — leaving the thread open for any late regressions. If anything crosses rollback criteria, call it out and @rajiv will execute rollback.

taylor: All clear at 16:37 UTC. No rollback. Marking as complete. :tada:

ellie: Great work — please add short deploy notes to the release doc (infra/releases/epsilon/2026-03-17.md) with observed metrics and config diff. Closing thread.
